Gaps are minor: the infection definition is collapsed to a single concept and the check_for list omits the three measurements the priority rule uses.

elements.problem: Diagnosis rule (claudication AND (rest pain OR gangrene) AND ulcer) is right, probable type is right. The Urgent priority rule relies on active_condition of the CLI diagnosis rather than restating the criteria, so it only fires if diagnosis chaining works; if it does not, this urgent trigger is lost. Also the page does not strictly require the ulcer to be an additional term beyond the box trigger; fine.

Urgent: skin ulcer or non-healing wound with critical limb ischaemia :: (active_condition (snomed_concept "Critical lower limb ischemia" "disorder"))

rule_level_problems.problem: Pressure-site ulcers and lower-limb ulcer sites are listed as check_for items although they are findings of the ulcer itself; history prompts (trauma, surgery, rash, burn, cancer, radiotherapy) and genital ulcer route not represented; no rule for the non-lower-leg non-pressure 'cause uncertain' branch.
Large repeated negation blocks for pressure-site exclusion are correct de Morgan expansions but a single missed site change would desync them; verified consistent in the file.

summary: The diagnostic flowchart (pressure, arterial, venous, diabetic) and both urgent triggers are encoded with correct thresholds, logic and rule types; no outright errors or missing red-box criteria found. Most consequential weakness: the CLI urgent priority rule depends on chaining from another diagnosis rule, and the infection definition and genital ulcer / uncertain-cause branches are simplified or absent.
